product.name: EdunationOS
product.description: A unified digital platform that integrates school management, learning, and engagement into a single ecosystem supporting multi-campus and multi-curricula environments with multilingual capabilities.

identifier.value: ACTUS Inspection Preparation and Recommendation System

product.name: ACTUS Inspection Preparation and Recommendation System
product.description: A system that collects and analyzes academic data to prepare schools for inspections and accreditation by identifying gaps and providing targeted improvement recommendations.

product.name: EduPay
product.description: An integrated e-payment solution for schools that enables fee requests, payment processing, tracking, and management through a secure, multi-currency, and multi-language platform.

product.name: EduSync
product.description: A data migration and import tool that enables schools to transfer data from third-party systems into Edunation LMS with automatic column matching and data integrity checks.

product.name: Edunation Forms
product.description: A digital forms solution that allows schools to create, distribute, and analyze smart, multilingual forms for various administrative and academic purposes.

product.name: Edunation Connect (SSO)
product.description: A single sign-on authentication system that provides secure, unified access to multiple educational tools and platforms with multi-factor authentication options.
